real_defects.issue: A row with only a delivery, marketing or ad charge (no subtotal, commission or error charge), such as a DoorDash ads billing line, was skipped as 'no amount', so that spend vanished from every total. Reproduced: a -50 ad-spend row left summary.ads at 0. Fixed: 'no amount' now means food sales and every charge column are blank.

Dot-separated dates (03.06.2026, the European day.month.year form) were read month-first whenever every day in the file was 12 or under, so a short Uber Eats export from Germany put June orders in March and on the wrong weekdays. Reproduced with two rows. Fixed: detectDmy treats dotted dates as day-first unless a second part is above 12.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
